title: Classical Liberal Statecraft: Baron József Eötvös
grammar: Constitutional Philosophy and The Limits of State Power
goal: I can say what the text about Eötvös says about state power and liberty.

I can explain in simple Hungarian why unlimited state power threatens liberty.
